'''June 2001 Honolulu tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Honolulu, HI on 2 June 2001. It is known from Donovan Lim's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2424">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-08-honolulu-hi-6-2-01d2424/ honolulu-hi-6-2-01], DeckTech (Donovan "topspinelite" Lim, 8 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-08-honolulu-hi-6-2-01d2424/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Honolulu, HI
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
